rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; over 100 primary studies aggregated across 298 study-site combinations with diverse scanners and acquisition protocols

rci5_n.detail: Overall phase; no explicit train/test split — all control subjects used for GAMLSS model fitting per phenotype. N varies across models because not all primary studies contributed data for all phenotypes. Counts computed from Supplementary Table 1.2–1.8. Additionally, 34 regional cortical volume models were built but are not enumerated here.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "GAMLSS models were fitted to structural MRI data from control subjects for the four main tissue volumes of the cerebrum"; "Supplementary Tables 1.1-1.8 present details on acquisition, processing and demographics of the dataset"; "SI1.2–SI1.42, demographic information per study and sex for each individual brain imaging phenotype (that is, SI1.2 has demographics for all control subjects included in the GMV model, SI1.3 for all subjects included in the WMV model, etc.)"
rci5_n.location: Bethlehem2021.pdf.md: Article, L45; Supplementary_Table_Information.md: Supplementary Table 1; Supplementary Tables 1.2–1.8 (Table_1_2 through Table_1_8 CSV files)

rci6_sex.detail: Overall phase; sex breakdown computed by summing Female and Male sample sizes across all studies per phenotype from Supplementary Tables 1.2–1.8
rci6_sex.supporting_text: Supplementary Tables 1.2–1.8 provide per-study, per-sex sample sizes for each phenotype model
rci6_sex.location: Supplementary Tables 1.2–1.8 (Table_1_2 through Table_1_8 CSV files)

rci7_age.detail: Overall phase; weighted mean age (years) computed from per-study, per-sex mean ages and sample sizes in Supplementary Tables 1.2–1.8. SD not reported per study group, so pooled SD cannot be computed. Age range spans from prenatal (post-conception) to ~100 postnatal years. The paper states the overall dataset spans '115 days post-conception to 100 years of age'. Min ages include fetal MRI data.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "we aggregated 123,984 MRI scans, across more than 100 primary studies, from 101,457 human participants between 115 days post-conception to 100 years of age"; Supplementary Tables 1.2–1.8 provide per-study Mean Age (in days), Minimum age (in days), Maximum age (in days)
rci7_age.location: Bethlehem2021.pdf.md: Article, L17; Supplementary Tables 1.2–1.8 (Table_1_2 through Table_1_8 CSV files)
